cohort: 458,918 women who delivered in Massachusetts between 2004 and 2010
finding: Women who conceived through ART had an elevated risk of severe maternal morbidity at delivery, largely indicated by blood transfusion, even when compared with a subfertile population.
mod_finding: Among singleton pregnancies, ART was associated with increased odds of severe maternal morbidity compared to both fertile and subfertile deliveries for both vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
